item.title: Still your grandfather’s boiler
item.description: Through a study of New Source Review, we empirically investigate how the differential treatment of coal boilers shaped the utilization, retirement and emissions of US coal generators.

item.title: AMI water meters deliver end-use water and financial savings in leaky households
item.description: Using 2WFE techniques we show that advanced metering infrastructure combined with targeted conservation messaging can significantly reduce residential water use, primarily by helping households detect and reduce leaks, generating both water savings and financial benefits.

item.title: Markets with power
item.description: We estimate counterfactual prices for the Australian National Electricity Market under the assumption of perfect competition and investigate to what extent market power contributed to elevated prices between 2015 and 2019.
